decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks fit closely with the firm's dental thermoforming and materials know-how, and its in-house R&D and quality capabilities make it likely to refine rather than abandon the product.
A PETG thermoforming blank is highly related to the firm's established dental laboratory materials business, so a large German manufacturer with strong R&D is likely to keep building this line.

UV-curing lacquer is related to the firm's materials expertise but was less prominently shown, so there is some risk, yet its absorptive capacity still favors learning and continued commercialization.
Intraoral contrast spray is somewhat adjacent to the core portfolio but still supports digital clinical workflows the firm is targeting, which argues for retention and incremental improvement.
A custom earmold product line builds directly on the firm's custom-device manufacturing and hearing-care channels, so early continuation is more likely than withdrawal.

Custom hearing protection earmolds are related to the firm's earmold and hearing-care capabilities, though slightly more niche, so management would likely keep them while using existing knowledge to develop the market.
